data.body_html:
Watching the New Year's Eve fireworks from a boat off Cabopino is one of the most memorable ways to welcome 2033. With no crowds, no traffic jams, and a front-row seat to the midnight sky, a private charter from Puerto Banús offers comfort and exclusivity. Our fleet includes everything from a compact speedboat for five to a 29-metre superyacht for twelve. Prices start at €749 for two hours, with skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks included. Here’s everything you need to know to secure your spot.

Why Cabopino for NYE 2033 Fireworks?

Cabopino is a small marina east of Marbella, known for its relaxed vibe and sandy coves. The fireworks display over Cabopino Beach is popular but the shore gets packed. From the water, you get an unobstructed view of the entire show, plus the reflection on the sea. The cruise from Boat Rental Marbella takes less than 20 minutes, so you can spend more time enjoying the evening.

Our Fleet: Best Boats for the Fireworks

We offer a range of boats departing from Puerto Banús. For a small group of up to 9 guests, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are ideal – both are 12.5m, cost €749 for 2 hours, and include everything. For up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (24m) is a standout at €4,719 for 4 hours, with a free jet ski included. Other options include the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), and the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). For the full list, see our fleet page.

What’s Included in Every Charter

All our charters come with a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden extras. You just show up at Puerto Banús, and the skipper handles navigation, anchoring, and safety. You can bring your own food and drinks if you wish.

Pricing: Transparent, No Surprises

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are fixed at €749 for 2 hours, €1,299 for 4 hours, €1,699 for 6 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (both white and grey) is €4,719 minimum 4 hours. For all other boats (Azimut 58, Ferretti 94, Pershing 46, etc.), pricing is on request via WhatsApp. We recommend booking early for NYE – demand is high.

Sample Itinerary for NYE 2033

  • 10:30 PM – Meet at Puerto Banús. Board your boat, meet the skipper, enjoy a welcome drink.
  • 11:00 PM – Depart east towards Cabopino. Cruise past Marbella’s Golden Mile lit up at night.
  • 11:20 PM – Anchor off Cabopino Beach. Settle in with snacks and bubbly.
  • 12:00 AM – Fireworks begin. Best view from the deck or flybridge.
  • 12:30 AM – Cruise back to Puerto Banús. Toast to 2033.

What to Bring for a December Evening

December evenings on the Costa del Sol are mild but can be cool – expect 12-16°C after sunset. Bring a warm jacket, especially if you plan to stay on the open deck. The boat’s saloon is heated, so you can warm up inside. We recommend non-slip shoes and a camera. Sunscreen is still advisable if you’re out before sunset.

How to Book Your Cabopino Boat Rental for NYE 2033

To secure your date, contact us via WhatsApp. For Tier A boats and Mangusta 80, you can book directly with the fixed rates. For other yachts, we’ll provide a personalised quote. A deposit is required to confirm. We recommend booking by October to ensure availability. For more tips on chartering in Marbella, check our blog.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best boat for a Cabopino NYE fireworks cruise?

For small groups, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are excellent. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) offers space for 12 guests and includes a free jet ski. All boats depart Puerto Banús, a short cruise from Cabopino.

How far is Cabopino from Puerto Banús by boat?

Cabopino is about 5 nautical miles east of Puerto Banús. At cruising speed (20-25 knots), the trip takes roughly 15-20 minutes. Your skipper will navigate directly to the best fireworks viewing spot.

What is included in the Cabopino boat rental price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs – just show up and enjoy.

Can I bring my own food or drinks on board?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. The boat already includes a selection of beverages and snacks, but you can customise your menu. Just let us know when booking.

How do I book a boat for NYE 2033 in Cabopino?

You can book directly via WhatsApp. For boats like the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, rates are fixed (€749/2h). For larger yachts, pricing is on request. We recommend booking early as NYE is peak season.

What time should we depart for the fireworks?

We suggest departing Puerto Banús around 10:30-11:00 PM. This gives you time to cruise to Cabopino, anchor comfortably, and enjoy drinks, snacks, and the atmosphere before midnight. The fireworks typically start at midnight.

Is the boat heated or covered for cold December evenings?

Most boats have a covered saloon and outdoor deck. The Azimut 58 Flybridge and larger yachts offer enclosed heated cabins. Dress warmly for the deck, but the interior provides shelter. Blankets are not provided – bring a jacket.

What happens if the weather is bad on NYE?

Your safety is paramount. If the forecast shows unsafe conditions, we will offer a full refund or reschedule. The skipper makes the final call. December evenings can be calm, but we monitor conditions closely.
